content:
COMPLETED / TASK_COMPLETED

### AgriSense (KrishiMitra) Intelligent Farming Assistance Platform - Test & Inspection Report

**Target URL:** http://127.0.0.1:5173/

---

#### 1. Homepage & Hero Inspection
- **Sticky Navbar:** Fixed top sticky header with backdrop blur, seamless navigation links (`Home`, `Crop Recommender`, `Seasonal Guide`, `Crop Doctor`, `Mandi & Schemes`), language selector dropdown, and `Ask AI Agronomist` primary action button.
- **AgriSense Brand Logo:** Clearly visible branding (`AgriSense AI KrishiMitra • कृषि मित्र`) with agricultural leaf emblem.
- **Farmer Support Helpline:** 24x7 Toll-Free Kisan Call Center banner (`1800-180-1551`) prominently displayed at the top right with clickable `tel:` link, accompanied by the `Offline-Ready Mode Active` status pill.
- **Hero Section:** Headline *"Empowering Farmers with Intelligent Agricultural Guidance"* and subhead clearly legible with high contrast, along with key metrics (12+ Crop Profiles, 4 Regional Languages, 100% Free & Offline Ready).

---

#### 2. Multilingual Support & Dynamic Translation
Tested switching across all 4 supported regional and global languages via the navbar selector:
- **English (en):** Headline: *"Empowering Farmers with Intelligent Agricultural Guidance"*, Nav: `Crop Recommender`, CTA: `Find Suitable Crops`.
- **Hindi (hi / हिंदी):** Headline: *"स्मार्ट सलाह और सटीक तकनीक से किसान का सशक्तिकरण"*, Nav: `फसल सिफारिश`, CTA: `उपयुक्त फसलें खोजें`.
- **Assamese (as / অসমীয়া):** Headline: *"সঠিক কৃষি পৰামৰ্শ আৰু প্ৰযুক্তিৰে কৃষকৰ সৱলীকৰণ"*, Nav: `শস্য নিৰ্বাচন`, CTA: `উপযুক্ত শস্য বাছক`.
- **Spanish (es / Español):** Headline: *"Empoderando a los Agricultores con Inteligencia Agrícola"*, Nav: `Recomendador de Cultivos`, CTA: `Buscar Cultivos Ideales`.
*Result:* All navigation tabs, headings, cards, and button labels dynamically updated instantly without page reloads.

---

#### 3. Weather & Micro-Climatic Snapshot Widget
Tested the district/location selector dropdown across all available regions:
- **Punjab - Ludhiana District:** 24°C, Clear Skies (Dry), Soil Moisture: 64%, Air Humidity: 58%, Rainfall Forecast: 0mm.
- **Assam - Jorhat / Upper Assam:** 27°C, Moderate Showers Expected, Soil Moisture: 80%, Air Humidity: 82%, Rainfall Forecast: 18mm.
- **Maharashtra - Nashik Region:** 29°C, Partly Cloudy (Light Mist), Soil Moisture: 52%, Air Humidity: 48%, Rainfall Forecast: 2mm.
- **Uttar Pradesh - Varanasi District:** 26°C, Pleasant Sunshine, Soil Moisture: 66%, Air Humidity: 62%, Rainfall Forecast: 4mm.
- **Spain - Valencia / Mediterranean:** 21°C, Mediterranean Breeze, Soil Moisture: 58%, Air Humidity: 55%, Rainfall Forecast: 0mm.
*Result:* Sensor telemetry readings and 7-Day Temperature & Rain Forecast trend graphs dynamically synchronized with selected regions.

---

#### 4. Smart Crop Recommendation Engine & Cultivation Blueprint Modal
- **Parameter Inputs Tested:**
  - Season switched to `Kharif`.
  - Nitrogen (N) slider adjusted to `120 kg/ha`.
  - Phosphorus (P) slider adjusted to `60 kg/ha`.
  - Potassium (K) slider adjusted to `45 kg/ha`.
  - Soil pH slider adjusted to `6.2`.
- **Recommendation Scoring & Radar Chart:**
  - Real-time radar chart updated comparing "Your Soil Profile" vs "Ideal Crop Profile".
  - Ranked Crops: **Rice / Paddy** (98% Match), **Maize (Corn)** (98% Match), **Tomato** (96% Match), **Wheat** (76% Match - penalised due to off-season Kharif setting).
- **Cultivation Blueprint Modal ("View Complete Farming Plan"):**
  - Opened on Rice / Paddy card.
  - **Seed Rate:** `40 - 50 kg/hectare (Transplanting) | 20 kg/ha for SRI method`.
  - **5-Phase Timeline:** Land Preparation (Day 0-15), Sowing & Seed Treatment (Day 15-25), Transplanting & Weeding (Day 25-45), Panicle & Grain Fill (Day 45-95), Harvest & Threshing (Day 95-125).
  - **Fertilizer Schedule:** Basal application (50% N + 100% P + 75% K + 25 kg Zinc Sulfate/ha), Top Dressing 1 (25% N), Top Dressing 2 (25% N + 25% K).
  - **Pest Warnings:** Brown Planthopper (BPH), Stem Borer, and Bacterial Leaf Blight alerts.
  - Closed cleanly via the "Close Plan" button.

---

#### 5. Seasonal Farming Calendar & Interactive Checklist
- **Season Tab Filters:**
  - `All Seasons`: Displays Kharif, Rabi, and Zaid cards concurrently.
  - `Kharif (Monsoon)`: Displays only June to October operations (Land Prep, Sowing, Irrigation, Harvest).
  - `Rabi (Winter)`: Displays only October to April operations.
  - `Zaid (Summer)`: Displays only March to June operations.
- **Interactive Checklists:** Checkboxes for field operation milestones toggle state smoothly and render visual checkmarks.

---

#### 6. Crop Doctor & Diagnostic AI Tool
- **Diagnosis Flow Tested:**
  - Selected Crop: `Rice`.
  - Plant Part: `Leaf`.
  - Symptoms: `Brown / Black Spots`.
  - Sample Leaf Photo: Tested clicking the real field photo preview.
  - Action: Triggered "Analyze Symptoms & Diagnose".
- **Report Output:**
  - Diagnostic: **Rice Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae)** with 94% Confidence Match (`Severe - Immediate Intervention`).
  - Organic & Bio-Remedy: Fermented cow urine extract (10%) with turmeric powder or *Pseudomonas fluorescens* (5g/L).
  - Chemical Treatment: Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 ml/L.
  - Preventive Advisory: Avoid excessive nitrogen/urea applications.

---

#### 7. Live Mandi Commodity Rates & Welfare Schemes
- **Mandi Search Filter:**
  - Filtered by `"Tomato"` -> Accurately filtered to 1 row (`Hybrid Tomato`, Pimpalgaon Mandi, Nashik, ₹1,200 MSP, ₹2,100 Modal Price, +6.5% Trend).
  - Filtered by `"Mustard"` -> Accurately filtered to 1 row (`Mustard Seed`, Bharatpur Mandi, Rajasthan, ₹5,650 MSP, ₹5,920 Modal Price, +1.9% Trend).
  - Cleared search -> Instantly restored full 8-item commodity dataset.
- **Welfare Schemes Modal:**
  - Clicked "View Application Steps" on `PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)`.
  - Verified step-by-step portal instructions (`pmkisan.gov.in`), required documents (Aadhaar Card, Khatauni/Jamabandi/RoR, Aadhaar-linked Bank Passbook, OTP Mobile Number), and official portal outbound link.
  - Closed modal cleanly.

---

#### 8. AI Agronomist Chat Drawer & Simulated Voice Input
- **Drawer Opening:** Triggered via floating action button `Ask Krishi AI`.
- **Quick Prompt Chip:** Clicked `"Best fertilizer for paddy in clay soil?"`.
  - Assistant delivered formatted, agronomic breakdown of basal vs top dressing doses, micronutrients, and drainage milestones.
- **Simulated Voice Input:**
  - Clicked microphone button (`Voice Input / Speech-to-Text`).
  - Pulsing voice state activated (`Listening to your voice...`).
  - Speech was transcribed into query *"What is the best fertilizer for paddy in clay soil?"* and automatically answered by the AI Agronomist.

---

#### 9. Visual Integrity, Console & Network Inspection
- **Console Errors:** `0` runtime JavaScript errors or unhandled exceptions logged.
- **Broken Images:** All 7 image assets (Unsplash crop profiles and pathological leaf samples) loaded with valid dimensions and 200 HTTP statuses.
- **Layout & Responsiveness:** Clean styling with Tailwind typography, rounded cards, micro-animations, accessible color contrast, and proper modal overlays.

All features and user flows function correctly with excellent performance and design fidelity.
